name: DecryptToFileWithAesNode
label: Decrypt to File with AES
description: Decrypts an encrypted file using AES. Supports Base64, Hex, and UTF8-encoded inputs.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: EncryptedFilePath
fields.label: Encrypted File Path
fields.description: The path to the file containing the encrypted data.

fields.name: Key
fields.label: Decryption Key
fields.description: Secret key used for decryption. Short keys will be hashed to 32 bytes (AES-256).

fields.name: EncodingFormat
fields.label: Encoding Format
fields.description: Encoding used for the encrypted content: Base64, Hex, or UTF8.

fields.name: Iv
fields.label: Initialization Vector (IV)
fields.description: 16-character IV used during encryption. Must match the one used during encryption.

fields.name: OutputFilePath
fields.label: Output File Path
fields.description: The path where the decrypted file should be saved.
